_doc: Material regions and parts on the body surface. s = station parameter (index into body_spec stations: 1 nose 2.25, 6 cowl 1.40, 7 0.92, 8 0.50, 11 -0.62, 12 -0.90, 13 -1.25, 15 -1.58, 18 tail -1.93), p = half-profile parameter (0 bottom centre, 3 sill, 7 crest, 9 glass base, 10 roof rail, 11 glass inner, 12 top centre). First matching rule wins.
